svg.title: Any length in, 8 x 12 numbers out: the network's fixed-size input
svg.desc: Six heatmaps in three pairs. Each pair shows one recording: first its MFCC frames, 41, 30 and 55 frames long, drawn to scale, then the same recording averaged into 8 equal slices of time. After slicing, all three recordings have the same size, and the two recordings of seven look alike.
svg.text: Any length in, 8 x 12 numbers out: the network's fixed-size input
